title: Submission of information
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Submission of information Dec 16, 1992| Circulars ]Ref. SMD-I/21766 December 16, 1992 To, The Presidents/Executive Directors of Bombay/ Ahmedabad/ Calcutta/Madras/ Delhi/Hyderabad/Indore/Bangalore/ Cochin/Kanpur/Pune/ Ludhiana/ Gauhati/ Mangalore /Patna/Jaipur/ Bhubaneshwar/Saurashtra Kutch and Vadodara Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Submission of information Please arrange to send us the following information at the earliest : - 1. Number of companies listed as on November 30,1992. 2. Average daily turnover of the shares & debentures rated at the Exchange. Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter. Yours faithfully, sd/- (Chandrashekhar Tilak)
